description: Closing structural test for the scaffolding hypothesis: ask whether the OGDHc-binding surface of the catalytic relative is experimentally defined at all (UniProt/RCSB structure cross-references for human ABHD11 and CG14717), then compare human-fly sequence identity and solvent exposure region by region on the AlphaFold model, separating the alpha/beta hydrolase core from the cap insertion where alpha/beta hydrolase protein-protein contacts normally sit
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- 1. Are there ANY experimental structures / defined interfaces? ----------
def uni(acc):
    return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=60).json()
def seq_of(j): return j["sequence"]["value"]

J = {a:uni(a) for a in ["Q8NFV4","Q9VGJ4","Q9W3R8","P75736"]}
print("Experimental structure cross-references (UniProt xref database=PDB):")
for a,j in J.items():
    pdbs=[x["id"] for x in j.get("uniProtKBCrossReferences",[]) if x["database"]=="PDB"]
    nm=j.get("proteinDescription",{}).get("recommendedName",{}).get("fullName",{}).get("value","")
    print(f"  {a:8s} {nm[:44]:46s} PDB: {pdbs if pdbs else 'NONE'}")

# RCSB full-text search for any ABHD11-containing entry
q={"query":{"type":"terminal","service":"full_text","parameters":{"value":"ABHD11"}},
   "return_type":"entry","request_options":{"paginate":{"start":0,"rows":25}}}
r=requests.post("https://search.rcsb.org/rcsbsearch/v2/query",json=q,timeout=60)
print("\nRCSB full-text 'ABHD11':", r.status_code,
      [h["identifier"] for h in r.json().get("result_set",[])] if r.status_code==200 else "no hits")
q2=dict(q); q2["query"]={"type":"terminal","service":"full_text","parameters":{"value":"CG14717"}}
r2=requests.post("https://search.rcsb.org/rcsbsearch/v2/query",json=q2,timeout=60)
print("RCSB full-text 'CG14717':", r2.status_code,
      [h["identifier"] for h in r2.json().get("result_set",[])] if r2.status_code==200 else "no hits")

# ---------- 2. human/fly identity by structural region ----------
B="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"; I={c:i for i,c in enumerate(B)}
M=np.array([[4,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-1,0,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,0,-3,-2,0],
[-1,5,0,-2,-3,1,0,-2,0,-3,-2,2,-1,-3,-2,-1,-1,-3,-2,-3],
[-2,0,6,1,-3,0,0,0,1,-3,-3,0,-2,-3,-2,1,0,-4,-2,-3],
[-2,-2,1,6,-3,0,2,-1,-1,-3,-4,-1,-3,-3,-1,0,-1,-4,-3,-3],
[0,-3,-3,-3,9,-3,-4,-3,-3,-1,-1,-3,-1,-2,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1],
[-1,1,0,0,-3,5,2,-2,0,-3,-2,1,0,-3,-1,0,-1,-2,-1,-2],
[-1,0,0,2,-4,2,5,-2,0,-3,-3,1,-2,-3,-1,0,-1,-3,-2,-2],
[0,-2,0,-1,-3,-2,-2,6,-2,-4,-4,-2,-3,-3,-2,0,-2,-2,-3,-3],
[-2,0,1,-1,-3,0,0,-2,8,-3,-3,-1,-2,-1,-2,-1,-2,-2,2,-3],
[-1,-3,-3,-3,-1,-3,-3,-4,-3,4,2,-3,1,0,-3,-2,-1,-3,-1,3],
[-1,-2,-3,-4,-1,-2,-3,-4,-3,2,4,-2,2,0,-3,-2,-1,-2,-1,1],
[-1,2,0,-1,-3,1,1,-2,-1,-3,-2,5,-1,-3,-1,0,-1,-3,-2,-2],
[-1,-1,-2,-3,-1,0,-2,-3,-2,1,2,-1,5,0,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,1],
[-2,-3,-3,-3,-2,-3,-3,-3,-1,0,0,-3,0,6,-4,-2,-2,1,3,-1],
[-1,-2,-2,-1,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,-1,-2,-4,7,-1,-1,-4,-3,-2],
[1,-1,1,0,-1,0,0,0,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-2,-1,4,1,-3,-2,-2],
[0,-1,0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,5,-2,-2,0],
[-3,-3,-4,-4,-2,-2,-3,-2,-2,-3,-2,-3,-1,1,-4,-3,-2,11,2,-3],
[-2,-2,-2,-3,-2,-1,-2,-3,2,-1,-1,-2,-1,3,-3,-2,-2,2,7,-1],
[0,-3,-3,-3,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,3,1,-2,1,-1,-2,-2,0,-3,-1,4]])
def nw(a,b,gap=-10):
    ea=np.array([I.get(c,-1) for c in a]); eb=np.array([I.get(c,-1) for c in b]); n,m=len(a),len(b)
    S=np.full((n,m),-1,int); ok=ea>=0; S[ok]=M[ea[ok]][:,eb.clip(0)]; S[:,eb<0]=-1
    F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    F[0,1:]=gap*np.arange(1,m+1); P[0,1:]=2; F[1:,0]=gap*np.arange(1,n+1); P[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        prev=F[i-1]; cur=F[i]; srow=S[i-1]; prow=P[i]
        diag=prev[:-1]+srow; up=prev[1:]+gap; best=np.maximum(diag,up); wu=up>diag
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            v=best[j-1]; left=cur[j-1]+gap
            if left>v: cur[j]=left; prow[j]=2
            else: cur[j]=v; prow[j]=1 if wu[j-1] else 0
    i,j=n,m; A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0: A.append(a[i-1]); Bb.append(b[j-1]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==1: A.append(a[i-1]); Bb.append("-"); i-=1
        else: A.append("-"); Bb.append(b[j-1]); j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb))

sf, sh = seq_of(J["Q9VGJ4"]), seq_of(J["Q8NFV4"])
af, ah = nw(sf, sh)
# map fly residue number -> identical-to-human flag
flyid={}; i=j=0
for x,y in zip(af,ah):
    if x!="-": i+=1
    if y!="-": j+=1
    if x!="-" and y!="-": flyid[i]=1 if x==y else 0
print(f"\nhuman/fly global alignment: {sum(flyid.values())}/{len(flyid)} identical in aligned columns "
      f"({100*sum(flyid.values())/len(flyid):.1f}%)")

# ---------- 3. AlphaFold model + SASA ----------
md=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q9VGJ4",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(md["pdbUrl"],timeout=60).text
atoms=[]
for L in pdb.splitlines():
    if L.startswith("ATOM"):
        atoms.append((int(L[22:26]),L[12:16].strip(),L[17:20].strip(),
                      float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54]),float(L[60:66])))
A=pd.DataFrame(atoms,columns=["resi","name","resn","x","y","z","b"])
R={"C":1.70,"N":1.55,"O":1.52,"S":1.80}
A["r"]=[R.get(n[0],1.7) for n in A.name]
XYZ=A[["x","y","z"]].values; rad=A.r.values+1.4
N=120; k=np.arange(N)+0.5
ph=np.arccos(1-2*k/N); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*k
SP=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(ph)]
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
T=cKDTree(XYZ); sasa=np.zeros(len(A))
for i in range(len(A)):
    pts=XYZ[i]+rad[i]*SP
    nb=[x for x in T.query_ball_point(XYZ[i],rad[i]+rad.max()) if x!=i]
    acc=np.ones(N,bool)
    for n2 in nb:
        acc &= (((pts-XYZ[n2])**2).sum(1) > rad[n2]**2)
    sasa[i]=4*np.pi*rad[i]**2*acc.mean()
A["sasa"]=sasa
TIEN={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'Q':225,'E':223,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,
      'L':201,'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
three={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
res=A.groupby(["resi","resn"],as_index=False).agg(sasa=("sasa","sum"),plddt=("b","mean"))
res["aa"]=res.resn.map(three)
res["rsa"]=res.sasa/res.aa.map(TIEN)
res["ident"]=res.resi.map(flyid)

# cap insertion of the alpha/beta hydrolase fold: between the catalytic acid (fly Asp144)
# and the catalytic histidine (fly His282); core = everything else past the presequence
core=res[(res.resi>=35)&((res.resi<144)|(res.resi>282))]
cap =res[(res.resi>=144)&(res.resi<=282)]
out=[]
for lab,d in [("core (35-143, 283-306)",core),("cap insertion (144-282)",cap)]:
    dd=d.dropna(subset=["ident"])
    exp=dd[dd.rsa>0.25]; bur=dd[dd.rsa<0.10]
    out.append(dict(region=lab,n=len(dd),ident_all=dd.ident.mean(),
                    n_exposed=len(exp),ident_exposed=exp.ident.mean(),
                    n_buried=len(bur),ident_buried=bur.ident.mean(),
                    mean_plddt=d.plddt.mean()))
S=pd.DataFrame(out)
print("\nHuman/fly identity by structural region (fly numbering):")
print(S.round(3).to_string(index=False))

from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
e_cap=cap.dropna(subset=["ident"]); e_cap=e_cap[e_cap.rsa>0.25]
e_core=core.dropna(subset=["ident"]); e_core=e_core[e_core.rsa>0.25]
tab=[[int(e_cap.ident.sum()),int((1-e_cap.ident).sum())],
     [int(e_core.ident.sum()),int((1-e_core.ident).sum())]]
odr,p=fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"\nExposed residues, cap vs core identity to human: {tab}  Fisher OR={odr:.2f} p={p:.3f}")

res.to_csv("CG14717_perresidue_rsa_identity.csv",index=False)
S.to_csv("CG14717_region_identity_summary.csv",index=False)

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7.2),sharex=True,
                      gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2,1]})
ax=axes[0]
d=res.dropna(subset=["ident"]).sort_values("resi")
w=11
sm=d.ident.rolling(w,center=True,min_periods=4).mean()
ax.plot(d.resi,sm,color="#2b4f81",lw=1.9,label=f"identity to human ABHD11 ({w}-residue mean)")
ax.axhline(d.ident.mean(),color="#888",ls=":",lw=1.2)
ax.text(306,d.ident.mean()+0.012,f"global {d.ident.mean():.2f}",fontsize=8.5,color="#666",ha="right")
ax.axvspan(144,282,color="#f2c14e",alpha=0.22)
ax.text(213,0.86,"cap insertion (144-282)",ha="center",fontsize=10,color="#8a6d14")
ax.axvspan(1,34,color="#cccccc",alpha=0.5); ax.text(17,0.86,"MTS",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#555")
for x,lab,col in [(120,"Gly120\n(was Ser)","#c0392b"),(144,"Asp144","#2e7d32"),
                  (282,"His282","#2e7d32"),(53,"Asp53\n(oxyanion)","#c0392b")]:
    ax.axvline(x,color=col,lw=1.1,ls="--",alpha=0.85)
    ax.text(x,0.02,lab,rotation=0,fontsize=8,color=col,ha="center",va="bottom")
ax.set_ylabel("identity to human ABHD11"); ax.set_ylim(0,0.95)
ax.legend(loc="upper left",fontsize=9,frameon=False)
ax.set_title("CG14717 versus human ABHD11: the cap insertion, where this fold normally makes protein contacts, "
             "is its most divergent exposed surface",fontsize=12)
ax=axes[1]
col=np.where(d.rsa>0.25,"#d98c5f","#5f84d9")
ax.bar(d.resi,d.rsa,color=col,width=1.0)
ax.axhline(0.25,color="#444",lw=0.8,ls=":")
ax.axvspan(144,282,color="#f2c14e",alpha=0.22)
ax.set_ylabel("relative SASA"); ax.set_xlabel("CG14717 residue (Q9VGJ4 numbering)")
ax.set_xlim(0,308)
plt.show()
